definition: φυσικός, -ή, -όν  (ψύσις), natural  __(a) produced by nature, innate (Xen., Arist., al.);  __(b) according to nature (Arist., Diod., al.): opposite to παρὰ φύσιν, Rom.1:26-27;  __(with) governed by mere natural instinct (of. Plut., Mor., 706 A): ζῷα γεγεννημένα φ. (RV, born mere animals; Mayor, born creatures of instinct; ICC, animals born of mere nature), 2Pe.2:12,† (AS)
